properties.title: Large-Signal Properties in MnZn Ferrites: Code and Data (datasets)
properties.citation: T. Guillod, W. V. R. Roberts, C. R. Sullivan, 'Characterization and Impact of Large-Signal Dielectric Properties in MnZn Ferrites', IEEE APEC 2024, doi:10.1109/APEC48139.2024.10509366; data: github.com/otvam/large_signal_ferrite_apec24 (MIT)
properties.description: Real permittivity and conductivity of TDK N87 (small signal, vs temperature, vs peak electric field); independent laboratory measurements.

evidence.description: MIT-licensed dataset of the APEC 2024 paper.

provenance.normalization: MATLAB data.mat variables read with scipy.io (float64, unmodified); degC -> K; electric field and conductivity in the SI units used by the authors' solver (code prints 1e-3*E as V/mm; sigma enters the complex permittivity with epsilon_0).
